idc-futurescape-2014-006.note: Wikipedia (citing PwC/Strategy&) confirms 21% of large public companies had a CDO by 2020, but that measures CDO presence, not CIOs supplanted by a CDO for digital product delivery; no survey of the same population and behaviour exists for 2019-2020 (session rule, D22/D23 same-quantity), so the bound argument does not support a published verdict.

idc-futurescape-2015-003.note: Convergedigest/IDC confirms public cloud services ~$183B in 2018; worldwide IT spending ~$3.7T (Gartner 2018; Businesswire page 403, figure well documented). Even IDC whole cloud (~$0.4T in 2018) over IT spending excluding telecom and devices is about 25%, far below the 40% needed for partial: miss.

idc-futurescape-2015-006.note: IoT Analytics (2018-08) confirms 7B IoT devices (excl. phones, tablets, PCs) and 17B connected devices of all kinds in 2018. 22B is 214% above the IoT count and 29% above even the all-devices count (error over actual; grader B's 23% uses the wrong denominator): miss.

idc-futurescape-2017-003.note: Help Net Security (IDC, 2021-09) confirms shared cloud services $385B and dedicated $5B in 2021, with as-a-service at 55.7% of whole cloud in 2021, implying whole cloud of about $700B; comsoc confirms public cloud $408.6B and cloud infrastructure $73.9B in 2021. Same-scope IDC measure above $530B: hit.

idc-futurescape-2018-010.note: Gartner 2022 IaaS shares (reprint, indianchemicalnews): Amazon 39.9, Microsoft 21.5, Alibaba 7.7, Google 7.5 = 76.6%; Synergy Q4 2022 confirms top three 73% of public IaaS/PaaS (Alibaba not given, ~4-5% assumed). Revenue share as the dominant reading of 'host deployments'; ~77% is within 10% of 80%: hit. Zawya link returned 400; figures checked via the 2023 Gartner reprint.

idc-futurescape-2019-010.note: Gartner 2023 IaaS reprint (indianchemicalnews) confirms top five (Amazon 39, Microsoft 23, Google 8.2, Alibaba 7.9, Huawei 4.3) at 82%; Synergy Q4 2023 confirms top three alone at 73% of public IaaS/PaaS. Threshold 'at least 75%' met under the IaaS/PaaS reading the megaplatform framing supports: hit. Grader B cited Q4 2022 Synergy, not 2023; result unchanged.

idc-futurescape-2024-006.note: McKinsey State of AI 2025 (page 503; figures confirmed via search snippets of the report and coverage): 23% of organizations scaling agentic AI in at least one function, 39% more experimenting, at most ~10% scaled in any one function. Same population and behaviour in the target year; 50% vs 23% is a miss. The experimenting reading (62%) would give partial, but 'use ... to achieve business value' reads as deployment.
